name: UniXNU Picasso WCN3990 Wi-Fi driver package
kind: self-contained source package, archived into the host tree's existing libNativeWlan.a

baseline.note: Current upstream tip of stage12/picasso-ios16; the four integration patches are regenerated against it.

integration.method: apply integration/ patches to a clean 00ea4a0 tree
integration.disable_behaviour: with wifi=0 or absent the package is inert and the tree is stock upstream
integration.linking: -force_load the single existing archive; the stock CONFIG_XNU_NATIVE_WLAN gate drives the build

platform_dependencies: the device's own modem GPT partition and its FAT/BDF content

implemented: WLFW QMI: BDF download, FW_READY_IND, mission mode
rmtfs / EFS and pd-mapper / TFTP service
GPT parsing on 4 KiB-sector UFS, FAT reader for the modem image
Apple80211 kern_control ioctl bridge to wifid
CE0/CE2/CE3 ring programming (64-bit descriptors, shadow write indices, dcache flush)
WMI-TLV INIT, START_SCAN, SCAN_EVENT and MGMT_RX beacon decoding
real scan results via the Apple80211 sta bridge (no hard-coded BSSIDs)
not_implemented: Metal / GPU interaction (intentionally out of scope)
real TX data path: picasso_wlan_transmit() still forges DHCP/ARP replies locally

known_upstream_note: the reference hakios-picasso stack fed six hard-coded BSSIDs and forged DHCP/ARP; the fake scan list has been removed, the fake data path is still present
